newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian starts Fiplasto.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian starts Fiplasto.

text.p: - Caspian Securities said it initiated coverage of Argentine fiberboard manufacturer Fiplasto SA with a "buy".
- It set a 12-month price target of $5.70, representing a 31 percent rise from its current $4.35 price.
- EPS growth is forecast at 21 percent this year, 18 percent in 1998 and 10 percent in 1999.

- "Having completed a $11.5 million investment last year, the initial stage of a three-part investment plan, Fiplasto is now poised to benefit from Argentina's growth of above five percent over the next two years," said Caspian.
